'''The Hole''' was an establishment in a seedy part of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], situated next to [[Enmonst Rclub/Legends|Enmonst Rclub]]. An [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] neon sign spelled out the name. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] stayed in an apartment near The Hole, while planning the [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|Mission to the Jedi Temple]].<ref name="HH" />

==Behind the scenes==
During pre-production, the establishment that became The Hole was known as "Bigrock", as seen in concept art of the Coruscant underworld. In the concept art, an Aurebesh sign over the name of the establishment says "lal".<ref name="SW-Holocron Heist - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep201|text="Holocron Heist" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 10}}</ref>
